_what_this_is: DEMO PROFILE — readiness thresholds for the live defense session only. A single pasted transcript cannot meet the production bar (config/readiness_policy.json: 5 of 7 fields evidenced), so this profile lowers the draft-level thresholds and the runner's --demo-profile flag records its use in the run manifest. Production runs never load this file.
_verdict_rule: ready_for_review requires BOTH conditions to hold; otherwise thin_input_return_to_client.
